$comment: Entry schema for contributes.aiCatalogs (process plugins only, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_ai_catalogs.go and ai_catalog_invoke.go. kind is one of {{lists.kinds}}: 'mcp' catalogs appear in Settings > AI > Connectors > Discover and 'skill' catalogs in Settings > AI > Skills > Discover, next to the built-in and online sources. searchAction and installAction must name this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read' that are not aiCallable, so the model can never reach a catalog. The host calls searchAction through plugin_host_ai_catalog_search with {catalog, kind, query, locale} (query <= {{limits.queryMaxRunes}} characters, payload <= min(action maxPayloadBytes, {{limits.payloadMaxBytes}}) bytes, timeout {{limits.timeoutMs}} ms) and expects {"items": [{id, name, description?, docsUrl?}]} (<= {{limits.resultMaxBytes}} bytes, first {{limits.itemsMax}} items kept, invalid items dropped; docsUrl is an absolute http(s) URL opened in the system browser only when the user clicks it). Only when the user adds an item does the host call installAction through plugin_host_ai_catalog_install with {catalog, kind, id, locale} and expect {"content": string} (<= {{limits.installResultMaxBytes}} bytes): an MCP server configuration JSON for 'mcp' or a SKILL.md document for 'skill'. The host never fetches a plugin-supplied URL. An added item becomes an ordinary user connector or skill: editable, removable and kept when the plugin is uninstalled; a connector is not connected until the user connects it.
description: AI catalogs: searchable connector (MCP) and skill sources that appear in the Settings > AI Discover tabs, served by this plugin's read actions.

searchAction.description: Id of one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read', not aiCallable.

installAction.description: Id of one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read', not aiCallable.
